description: Two pages in the same batch model tokenizer containment at different depths. create-custom-analyzer.md and default-analyzers-reference.md consistently state a tokenizer is a component of an ANALYZER (analyzer -> tokenizer/character-filter/token-filter), which is itself scoped to a type mapping, not asserted as a direct property of the index. default-tokenizers-reference.md instead states 'Tokenizers control how the Search Service splits input strings into individual tokens' and models this as the Search index containing the tokenizer directly, skipping the analyzer and type-mapping levels every other page in the same module respects. The quoted sentence does not actually assert direct containment - it is a looser, coarser claim than the rest of the module's careful chain, and the two depths were never reconciled by any page.
